## Problem 1
```{r echo = F, message = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
penguins
```

The penguins dataset includes size measurments for adult foraging penguins near Palmer Station Antartica.
It contains measurements for `r nrow(penguins)` penguins across `r ncol(penguins)` variables. 
The mean flipper length is `r mean(pull(penguins, flipper_length_mm), na.rm = TRUE)`
`
```{r}
# scatterplot

penguin_plot = ggplot(penguins, aes(x= bill_length_mm, y= flipper_length_mm, color = species)) + geom_point()

ggsave(penguin_plot)
```
